decisionTree.if: layout-bearing AND shape known AND duration 300ms–3s
shape unknown AND single replacement AND duration 300ms–1s
list/grid of similar items AND duration 300ms–3s
decisionTree.use: skeleton array sized to expected count
progress bar or percentage (real, not simulated)
render cached + stale marker; no spinner

skeletonRules: Skeleton blocks reserve the same space the final content will occupy.
Skeleton shimmer uses `continuous` motion role; respects prefers-reduced-motion (static placeholder).
Skeleton does not show counterfeit text or icons — only shape.
spinnerRules: Spinner overlays the target region, not the whole screen, unless the whole screen is loading.
Spinner is accompanied by copy (loading-state slot) for screen-reader context.
Spinner respects prefers-reduced-motion — static alternative or very slow rotation.
refusal: Spinner + skeleton simultaneously on the same region.
Skeleton that looks like real content and lies about the outcome (counterfeit).
